title.zh: 鱼鳍与四肢之间，化石告诉了我们什么？
title.en: What can a fossil tell us about fins and limbs?

dek.zh: 提塔利克鱼同时保留鱼类特征和与四足动物有关的身体结构。理解这种组合，比寻找一条“鱼变成人的直线”更有意义。
dek.en: Tiktaalik combines fish features with structures relevant to the origin of tetrapods. That combination is more informative than a straight line from fish to humans.

title.zh: 先看身体，而不是给它找一个祖先位置
title.en: Start with the body, not an ancestor label

text.zh: 提塔利克鱼的化石保留了鳞片和鳍条，也显示出可活动的颈部、粗壮的肋骨，以及带有类似腕部关节的胸鳍。它的意义在于：这些通常被我们分开讨论的结构，曾经可以出现在同一具身体上。
text.en: Tiktaalik retains scales and fin rays, alongside a mobile neck, robust ribs and a pectoral fin with wrist-like joints. Features we often discuss separately occur together in the same body.

title.zh: 过渡不等于一半鱼、一半陆生动物
title.en: A transition is a combination of features

text.zh: 研究者比较骨骼的形状、位置和关节连接，判断哪些结构与其他类群相似。“镶嵌性状”指的就是不同特征组合在一起。它帮助我们研究身体结构怎样变化，却不会自动把某个化石指定为后世动物的直接祖先。
text.en: Researchers compare the shape, position and connections of bones. A mosaic of features is a combination of traits associated with different groups. It informs the study of anatomical change without identifying a fossil as a direct ancestor.

title.zh: 有类似腕部的关节，是否就会在陆地上行走？
title.en: Does a wrist-like joint prove walking on land?

text.zh: 骨骼可以约束运动能力的解释，但身体结构与日常行为不是同一种证据。现有描述支持这组解剖特征；不能仅凭它们断言提塔利克鱼经常在陆地上行走。阅读这类研究时，把“保存了什么”和“据此推测什么”分开，才能理解结论的分量。
text.en: Anatomy constrains interpretations of movement, but a structure and an everyday behaviour are different kinds of evidence. These descriptions support the anatomical combination; they do not establish habitual walking on land. Distinguish what is preserved from what is inferred.

meaning.zh: 同一生物同时具有与不同类群有关的特征组合；不是进化完成了一半。
meaning.en: A combination of traits associated with different groups, rather than evolution being halfway finished.

title.zh: 开花植物的起源，为什么会有不同年代？
title.en: Why do flowering plants have different origin estimates?

dek.zh: 化石年龄与分子钟估计回答的不是同一个问题。先区分它们，才能读懂关于被子植物起源的讨论。
dek.en: A fossil age and a molecular-clock estimate answer different questions. Separating them makes debates about angiosperm origins easier to follow.

title.zh: 一件化石证明的是一个已出现的身体
title.en: A fossil records a body that already existed

text.zh: 早白垩世的 Montsechia 材料保存了柔软的带叶枝轴和封闭的单种子果实。这些是具体标本上的结构，可以用于讨论早期被子植物的形态与水生生活。它们没有记录下整个类群诞生的那一刻。
text.en: Early Cretaceous Montsechia material preserves flexible leafy axes and closed single-seeded fruits. These specimen-level structures inform discussion of early angiosperm morphology and aquatic life. They do not record the moment the whole group originated.

title.zh: 分子钟是在模型中估计分支时间
title.en: A molecular clock estimates branching times

text.zh: 分子钟研究把现生谱系的数据与化石校准结合，估计分支发生的时间。这里的“冠群”包括某个类群全部现生成员的最近共同祖先及其后代。不同校准和分析方法会影响估计，所以冠群年代不能直接写成最早化石年代。
text.en: Molecular-clock studies combine data from living lineages with fossil calibrations to estimate branching times. A crown group includes the last common ancestor of all living members and its descendants. Calibration and analysis choices affect the estimate, so a crown age is not a first fossil occurrence.

title.zh: 起源时间、化石记录和生态扩张要分别阅读
title.en: Origin, fossil occurrence and expansion are separate questions

text.zh: 某个年代已经存在开花植物，不等于它们当时已占据各种生态系统。一个水生化石也不能代表所有早期被子植物的祖先生态。把具体标本、模型估计和生态扩张分开，能避免用一个数字讲完一段复杂历史。
text.en: The presence of flowering plants at an age does not establish dominance across ecosystems. One aquatic fossil cannot represent the ancestral ecology of every early angiosperm. Keep specimens, model estimates and ecological expansion separate.

meaning.zh: 一个类群全部现生成员的最近共同祖先，以及该祖先的全部后代。
meaning.en: The last common ancestor of all living members of a group, together with all its descendants.

title.zh: 马、貘和犀牛，为什么要放在一起读？
title.en: Why read about horses, tapirs and rhinos together?

dek.zh: 奇蹄目的历史是一棵分支不断分化的树。现生动物的差异，与化石中早期支系的相似，共同构成了这个故事。
dek.en: Perissodactyl history is a branching record. Differences among living animals and similarities among early fossil branches belong to the same story.

title.zh: 从差异明显的现生动物回望早期分支
title.en: Look back from distinctive living animals

text.zh: 马、貘和犀牛各自具有明显不同的外形。奇蹄目早期分支的区分却常依靠牙齿和颅骨上的细微特征。研究这些差异，可以把今天容易辨认的类群与更早的化石记录联系起来。
text.en: Horses, tapirs and rhinoceroses look strikingly different today. Distinguishing early perissodactyl branches often relies on subtle dental and cranial features. Comparing them connects familiar living groups with the fossil record.

title.zh: 演化不是朝着现代马前进的队列
title.en: Evolution is not a queue leading to the modern horse

text.zh: 奇蹄目还包括许多已经灭绝的支系。牙齿、头骨和四肢在不同谱系中走出了不同的变化路径。把它们画成分支，比把几个化石按年代排成祖先队列更接近这段历史。
text.en: Perissodactyla also contains many extinct groups. Teeth, skulls and limbs changed along different lineages. A branching account is more faithful to that history than a row of fossils labelled as successive ancestors.

title.zh: 早期辐射与扩散，仍要依靠具体记录
title.en: Early diversification and dispersal need specific records

text.zh: 已有研究约束了始新世早期已采样支系的辐射与扩散，但不提供一个毫无误差的起源时刻，也不能给整个目指定同一种生活方式。继续阅读时，可以追问：这个结论涉及哪个支系、哪些地点，以及哪些保存下来的身体结构？
text.en: Studies constrain diversification and dispersal among sampled early Eocene branches. They do not supply an exact origin instant or one way of life for the whole order. Ask which lineage, places and preserved structures support each conclusion.

meaning.zh: 一个谱系分化出多个支系的过程；不意味着所有支系同时出现或采用相同的生活方式。
meaning.en: Diversification into multiple branches; it does not imply simultaneous origins or identical ways of life.

title.zh: 一群黑猩猩，能告诉我们怎样的栖地故事？
title.en: What can one chimpanzee community tell us about habitat?

dek.zh: 在几内亚 Bossou，森林和耕地交错的环境中，黑猩猩在哪里活动、在哪里取食？一年的跟踪观察让这个问题有了具体答案。
dek.en: Where do chimpanzees spend time and feed in a landscape of forest and farmland at Bossou, Guinea? A year of follows brings the question into focus.

title.zh: 先把研究地点放回故事里
title.en: Put the study location back into the story

text.zh: 研究者在几内亚 Bossou 跟踪一个野生西部黑猩猩群体，从 2012 年 4 月持续到 2013 年 3 月，每天至多观察 6 小时，其中包括十只成年重点观察个体。把每次活动与所在栖地对应起来，他们发现：总体上，成熟林是这个群体选择比例最高的栖地。森林并不是故事的模糊背景，而是动物每天作出选择的生活空间。
text.en: Researchers followed one wild western chimpanzee community at Bossou, Guinea, from April 2012 to March 2013, for up to six hours a day, including ten adult focal individuals. Matching activities to habitats showed that mature forest was the most selected habitat overall. Forest was a living space in which these animals made daily choices.

title.zh: 靠近耕地，取食记录发生了什么变化？
title.en: What changed near cultivated fields?

text.zh: 在非耕地栖地记录的取食事件中，距耕地超过 200 米的次数高于随机预期，距耕地 0–200 米的次数则低于预期。这里比较的不只是哪里有动物，而是观察到的取食位置与随机预期有什么差别。作者提出，耕地相关风险可能影响取食地点；这是一种对结果的解释，还不能把它写成已经证明的唯一原因。
text.en: Among feeding events in uncultivated habitats, observations more than 200 metres from fields exceeded chance expectations, while those within 0–200 metres fell below them. The comparison concerned feeding locations relative to chance, rather than just where animals occurred. The authors suggested that field-associated risks might influence feeding locations; the study did not establish that as the sole cause.

title.zh: 同一个物种，会有不同的地方生活
title.en: One species, different local lives

text.zh: 这项观察让我们看到，认识黑猩猩不能只停在分类名称上：生活地点和人类改变的环境也参与塑造它们的活动。但 Bossou 的一个群体并不代表所有黑猩猩。其他地区的食物、栖地和人类活动背景可能不同。继续进入物种详情，可以把这段当地生活与工具使用、成长和种群史的其他研究放在一起阅读。
text.en: The observations connect chimpanzee life with place and a landscape altered by people. But the Bossou community does not represent all chimpanzees: food, habitats and human activity differ between regions. The species page places this local account alongside studies of tool use, development and population history.

meaning.zh: 研究中被选定并持续跟踪记录的个体；它不是整个物种的平均代表。
meaning.en: An individual selected for sustained observation, rather than an average representative of an entire species.

title.zh: 研究狨猴父亲时，怎样区分联系与原因？
title.en: Studying marmoset fathers: association or cause?

dek.zh: 普通狨的研究把父亲的反应与幼仔结局联系起来。读懂这项发现，需要同时知道观察了什么，以及研究在哪里进行。
dek.en: A common marmoset study links paternal responsiveness with infant outcomes. Understanding it requires both the observed relationship and the study setting.

title.zh: 从幼仔的求救叫声开始
title.en: Start with an infant distress call

text.zh: 威斯康星一处研究圈养群体的研究纳入 24 位有育幼经验的普通狨父亲及 62 只幼体。研究者比较父亲对幼体求救叫声的反应，并把父亲是否回应与幼体后来的结果联系起来。育幼在这里变成一个可以观察的问题：幼仔发出信号时，父亲会不会回应？
text.en: A study at one Wisconsin research colony included 24 experienced common marmoset fathers and 62 offspring. Researchers compared fathers’ responses to infant distress calls and related responsiveness to later infant outcomes. Paternal care became an observable question: when an infant signals distress, does its father respond?

title.zh: 会回应的父亲，幼体结果有什么不同？
title.en: What differed among offspring of responsive fathers?

text.zh: 研究中，被归为会回应的父亲，其幼体超过一个月后的存活率较高；论文还报告第 28 和 30 周两组幼体体重有差异。这个结果把父亲的反应与幼体的成长联系起来。不过，“一起出现”比“前者导致后者”弱：这项研究不能单凭这种联系就证明，父亲的反应造成了存活率或体重的变化。
text.en: Offspring of fathers classified as responsive had higher survival beyond one month, and the paper reported weight differences between groups at weeks 28 and 30. The finding links paternal responsiveness with infant outcomes. That relationship alone does not establish that responsiveness caused the survival or weight differences.

title.zh: 圈养家庭的发现，怎样接到野外故事？
title.en: How does a captive-colony finding connect to wild life?

text.zh: 这些发现来自单一圈养群体，不能直接改写成野外普通狨的存活率。它提供的是一个具体的育幼研究入口。继续认识这个物种，还可以读它的白色耳簇与毛色、巴西的原生和引入记录，以及与近缘种杂交的研究。各个问题需要各自的材料，合在一起才逐步构成物种的生活图景。
text.en: These findings come from one captive colony and are not estimates of survival in wild common marmosets. They offer a specific route into paternal care. The species page also covers white ear tufts and pelage, native and introduced records in Brazil, and studies of hybridization with relatives. Each question needs its own evidence.

meaning.zh: 两个变量之间观察到的关系；仅凭这种关系不能确定一个变量导致另一个变化。
meaning.en: An observed relationship between variables that, on its own, does not establish that one causes changes in the other.
